items.title: Couture Fashion
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
New trends are here! The fashion festival of this year has begun, and everyone is trying out new styles. Be the first to put your hands on the latest drift and find yourself in unique currents! Everybody has time to party and of course, to buy clothes. Get ready!

+ 1 free skin
+ 15 stylish skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Anime Lovers
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description: Show your love for anime with this skin pack! With a wide variety of skins to choose from, there is the perfect style to fit anyone's anime needs!

items.title: Improved Caves
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Enjoy a world almost completely filled with caves to explore! Ground-level has been raised to allow for maximum cave exploration!

+ 5 unique cave layers~
+ Massive 4000 x 4000 world to explore!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Crypto Creepers
items.creator: House of How
items.description: A mischevious, playful kind of creeper hacks its way through the depths of the internet, twisting this web world as we know it. Rainbow colors, glowing neon, these mobs shed light on the shadows and give us all a new perspective. 15 cool looking creepers to choose from!

items.title: Space Bots
items.creator: House of How
items.description: A pack of 19 colorful, retro robots are blasting through outer space enroute to establish their very own city on a new planet near you! Join their metallic civilization and live out all of your sci-fi adventure fantasies!

items.title: Zombie Skeletons
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Super cool, super creepy. These skeletons have been brought back to life and are bringing with them all the terrors, spooks, and colors! 15 skins in all. Haunt your friends with these rainbow zombie skeletons!

items.title: Extreme Survival Island
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Beware this map is not for the faint hearted. 
Can you survive on an island with new animals? 
Your challenge is to survive 100 days and become the ultimate pro survival player. 
This tropical island is full of new exotic wildlife, from panthers, snakes and wild boar to less frightening crabs and rats.
items.changelog:
Update 1.0 

+ Animals and Creatures have had design, animation and textures changes.
+ Added 3 new snakes. Beware! 
+ Added Banana, Orange, Peach and Coconut Trees. Obtain these new foods! 
+ Added a Gecko Animal 
+ Catfish is now cookable and edible.
+ New Buildings throughout the map!

items.title: Pirate Skyblock
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
The pirates have gone crazy and are now in the skies! get the classic skyblock experience on huge flying pirate ships.

+ Many boats and biomes
+ By 4KS Studios and Street Studios

items.title: Gamer Mobs
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Are you a professional Minecraft player and you love mobs? Then this skin pack is great for you! Choose the coolest gamer mob skin now and show everyone who is the best player!

+ 16 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Gamer themed
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: MMORPG Stars
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Stylish MMORPG skins are coming to Minecraft! Just browse them all and start using your favorite skin!

+ 12 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ MMORPG themed
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Ninja Axolotls
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Have you ever seen a ninja Axolotl? Choose your favorite skin now and show off your ninja skills to other players!
WARNING: They are so cute and absolutely stunning!

+ Axolotl themed ninja skins
+ 12 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Sweater Weather
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Snuggle up with these cozy sweaters! Perfect for any activity such as snowball fights, sledding, or enjoying a cup of hot chocolate!

- 8 Cozy Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Cakes
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Dress up as a sweet desert! These skins allow for you to become a (literal) cake chef, judge or even a karate instructor!

+ 7 wild cake skins
+ Super random outfits

items.title: Breakfast
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Why eat your breakfast when you can become it?

- 7 food skins
- Sausages, bacon, beans, eggs and more!

items.title: 80 Teen Skins
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Show off to your friends with this huge bundle of 80 teenager skins! With a variety of trendy clothing designs, there's a skin to suit everyone. From rich millionaire skins, to anime outfits, to dark clothes, to neon hair - we're sure you'll be able to find your dream skin.

+ 80 unique skins

items.title: Dream Axolotls
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Dreaming of dragons, warlocks, & knights is scary while living in these caves. Especially with a warden in these depths! So wake up and swim away with these cute and adorable axolotl skins to avoid having a nightmare! You’ll dream better than ever with these cute axolotls! 

- 9 colorful pajama axolotls!
- Perfect for the caves and cliffs update!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Police
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
You always wanted to protect the law? With these 8 police skins you can face the crime!

+Comes with 1 free skin!
+By FallStudios

items.title: Random Drops
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
This world has a twist! Start off in this custom survival world, but everytime you break a block, you never know what you will get!

Will you master this survival challenge?

+ Every drop is random!
items.changelog: - Fully reworked the world & behavior pack - Added a new custom survival world - Random Drops are now up to version 1.21.132

items.title: Puppy Pageant
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
What's cuter than puppies, you ask? Well, puppies dressed up for a pageant, of course! In this skin pack, you have girl and boy puppies fighting for the title of the cutest dog and you get to pick the winner in this adorable skin pack.

- Ten Skins
- 1 Free Skin
